get.description: Read-only status for the session’s next question. Does not generate, enqueue or write. Stale means the session, claim, next ordinal or mandatory memory no longer matches the prepared candidate. A consumed preparation returns idle without jobId. A ready candidate is not a saved offer. Actual current approved claimant only; administrator status alone is insufficient. Bearer authentication is verified on every request; bearer tokens are never stored in the job. Private/no-store. Draft contract; not released.

409.description: Candidate is not ready or session, ordinal, memory or evidence changed.

200.description: Current preparation status. A ready candidate has not been offered yet.

jobId.description: Present when a preparation job exists.

errorCode.description: Safe failure classification only; never raw provider errors or private job payloads.

post.summary: Prepare or offer the next question
post.description: action=prepare queues durable work in the existing research-job system and returns preparation status without waiting for model generation. action=consume atomically rechecks the current session, ordinal, mandatory memory and evidence before saving a ready candidate as an offered question; it returns the saved question. At most three sequential questions per sitting. For a session that has explicitly opted into durable preparation, a successful saved answer queues preparation of the next question when another is allowed; legacy foreground sessions are unchanged. Preparation itself does not set offeredAt or expose a question to the artist. Actual current approved claimant only; administrator status alone is insufficient. Bearer authentication is verified on every request; bearer tokens are never stored in the job. Private/no-store. Draft contract; not released.
